name: open-knowledge
tagline_zh: 在 OpenKnowledge 项目里读写 .md 文件前，先让这个 skill 接管——它懂 CRDT 合并。
tagline_en: Before touching any .md in an OpenKnowledge project, let this skill handle it—CRDT-aware, search/edit/lint, no.
